entries.proposed_as: Re-run PR-2 with recovery_AUC substituting drop_magnitude as the consequence variable, motivated by PR-2's own diagnosis that drop_magnitude was saturated at n=10.

mechanism_under_test.implication: recovery_AUC is a monotone function of (1 - bridge_fraction) AND is normalised by the very quantity PR-2 measures, so delete_bridge moves it by construction. Note the counterintuitive direction: deleting a bridge LOWERS bridge_fraction (denominator n_edges shrinks too), which RAISES the R-a modulator and RAISES recovery_AUC -- i.e. it reports 'more recovery' when the system was cut. That is a denominator artifact, not a signal.

entries.decision_basis: NOT the rule's verdict. (a) Analytic: modulator_Ra contains bridge_fraction and recovery_AUC is normalised by drop_magnitude -- provable by reading compute_ablation, no empirical estimate needed. (b) Artifact rate 95.2% with 85.7% separation on the control arm -- a metric that splits the two arms at that rate is tracking the intervention, not reading it independently. (c) The rule is documented as underpowered on its own sample.

unexplored_alternatives.larger_n: Not pursued -- n changes effect size, not the denominator artifact.
unexplored_alternatives.t_half: Not pursued -- derived from the same trajectory, identical coupling.
unexplored_alternatives.required_to_proceed: A consequence measure that is NOT derived from bridge_fraction, e.g. a functional read-out under real dynamics. That is outside this project's current compute substrate.

entries.notes: This block records an experiment that was DECIDED AGAINST before execution. It is the R-0.4 discipline extended from 'failed experiments are reported' to 'not-run experiments are reported with their reason'. Boundary conclusion: with drop_magnitude effect size <= 0.001 at n <= 100 and no independent second read-out in the current metric family, L4 (causal) evidence for the bridge->isolation link is NOT attainable here. That is a substrate limit, not a sample-size limit -- it should be read as a scope boundary, not a failure to try harder.

power_diagnostic.note: The reject rule tests coupling on the BRIDGE arm only, whose var(d_bridge_fraction) is compressed to 1e-3 by the intervention itself (all bridges deleted), so 'is recovery_AUC monotone in bridge_fraction' is unresolvable on that sample. On both arms pooled (4.94x the variance) the coupling is CONFIRMED at |r| = 0.90-0.91. The rule's ACCEPT is a specification defect, not a clearance.
